features.name: Expense Agent multilingual support
features.description: Expense Agent now supports Danish, French, German, Spanish, and English languages with plans for more languages in October. The user interface and all strings translate to the local language.
caveats: Only five languages fully supported as of July; more to come in October
Spanish, Danish, and French shown as examples in this video

features.name: Expense Agent geographic expansion
features.description: Expansion to new countries: Austria, Denmark, France, Germany, Spain, UK, and Europe in EU; Canada in North America; Australia and New Zealand in APAC. More countries coming in October.

features.name: Multilingual receipt processing
features.description: Receipt images can be in any language; the Expense Agent extracts and categorizes information correctly regardless of the receipt language, even if different from the environment language.
caveats: Tested across almost all languages, but official support limited to five languages for now

features.name: Automatic receipt categorization in local languages
features.description: The Expense Agent automatically categorizes expenses (meal, hotel, etc.) and extracts all details from receipts, with full support for displaying categories in the local language.
